name: 4.8-dev6
body:
**Godot 4.8 dev 6** is a dev snapshot for the 4.8 feature release. Dev snapshots are in-development builds of the engine provided for early testing and feature evaluation while the engine is still being worked on.

Report bugs on GitHub after checking that they haven't been reported:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues

Built from commit [8898c2b3db32adf6f92c694ffb6dac19af672e5f](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/8898c2b3db32adf6f92c694ffb6dac19af672e5f).
To make a custom build which would also be recognized as dev6, you should define `GODOT_VERSION_STATUS=dev6` in your build environment prior to compiling.

----

- [Release notes](https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-8-dev-6/)
- [Complete changelog](https://godotengine.github.io/godot-interactive-changelog/#4.8-dev6)

----

name: 3.6.3-stable
body:
**Godot 3.6.3** is a maintenance release addressing stability and usability issues, and fixing all sorts of bugs. Maintenance releases are compatible with previous releases and are recommended for adoption.

Report bugs on GitHub after checking that they haven't been reported:
